notes.title: Ergo - New Beta build 24/01/2024
notes.content:
This update is linked to the Beta Branch, this does not effect the default branch

- New Main Menu (prettier)
- New Menu interface (better programmed with lots of buttons)
- Fixed several soft locks in early and late game levels
- Replaced one of the characters dialogue with A.E.I.O.U (Temp)
- Massively improved all UV's of objects
- Improved visuals
- Improved Keypad
- Fixed a bug where Keycard readers wouldn't read
- Fixed a bug where Keypad notes wouldn't note
- Improved performance
- Removed T-Posing mannys in some areas (whoops)
- Removed Trinket system (Unfun, Achievements stay for now as they're still acquirable in default branch)
- Improved models
- Improved Door code (Currently only applies to the menu)
- Keypads can now generate up to 10 digits
- Keypad keys are now physical
- Keypads now play notes depending on the key value
- Keycards now have a black outline to make them easier to find on the floor
- Better lighting

That's all for now!

- Rowan H

notes.title: Ergo Beta Branch Update
notes.content:
Hello, as said previously, updates would be slow, however I have updated the Beta Branch with a lighting upgrade, the worlds now feel prettier to look at, while nothing's finished yet I have included some comparison screenshots for you to look at

[b]OLD Screenshot (Steam Store Page)[/b]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1654520/ss_51f0c55a0c66dd38d605d0a6fb88be33a7b95713.jpg?t=1652121366[/img]
[b]Beta Branch[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/jaX4ALu.png+[/img]

[b]OLD Screenshot (Steam Store Page)[/b]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1654520/ss_0b73127708e40c93d1f4645608d6415d0c6e1f8d.jpg?t=1652121366[/img]
[b]Beta Branch[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/YlNlEYb.png[/img]

[b]Patchnotes[/b]

[b]Additions[/b]

[list]
[*] Some new assets will appear throughout the levels
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] The game no longer has a tint of green!
[*] Re-enabled texture streaming
[*] Enabled Virtual Textures
[*] Redesigned the Ergo item transport system
[*] Optimised button pathing
[*] Redesigned a level (unfinished but better than before)
[/list]


[b]Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where you could grab the collision of a vent, causing your hand to be stuck in place
[*] Fixed a bug where cups would break into the same piece
[*] Fixed object displacements
[*] Moved spawn placements of destructible parts (to decrease chance of physics explosion related crashing)
[/list]

I'm reworking the item spawning system to help keep the game running smooth, this system only applies to "Test one" and "Test three" as of writing but I will try to get it on all levels by the next Beta Update

How to access:
[previewyoutube=9AFIzm93v08;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Ergo Patchnotes 1.02
notes.content:
What's up future employees. I have released a new patch with a few fixes, Thank you for playing the game, hopefully these fixes and changes will make the game more enjoyable.

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed softlock on first test
[*]Possibly fixed random level resets
[*]Fixed a bug where the final dialogue would fail to play at the appropriate location
[*] [spoiler] fixed bug in final level where spheres would reenable gravity on the final level [/spoiler]
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Items that fall out of the map will now return to the player's location
[*] Removed a destructible table that was causing application instability
[*] Added some fake doors to some the first puzzle
[*] [spoiler] Changed Cons' appearance [/spoiler]
[*] Adjusted final scene to make it partially easier
[*] Made the level Frequent Oversight require more user cooperation
[/list]

[b]Steam fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Store page now mentions that it requires a vr headset to play
[*] Fixed launch option text for Oculus VR mode
[/list]

(Please note updates are not daily, I've just managed to fix these important issues)
